notes: Remake rules for repairing and capturing base objects and structures, one shared mechanic (engine/repair) with per-game data. The originals only disable an object at its disabled damage (Tribes 1 StaticShape::onDamage / Tribes 2 GameBase disabled damage state) and the repair pack brings it back (T1 scripts/item.cs RepairPack::onUse mounts the RepairGun, scripts/baseProjData.cs RepairBolt::onAcquire repairRate 0.05 /s on its own user, 0.1 /s on any other target, boltLength 5; T2 scripts/packs/repairpack.cs RepairGunImage: repairFactorPlayer 0.002 and repairFactorObject 0.004 per tick, DefaultRepairBeam beamRange 10, the beam finds players, vehicles, static shapes and turrets); Earthsiege 1, Earthsiege 2 and Starsiege have no repair of structures in the field at all (ES1 / ES2 repair only in the hangar, Starsiege has a NanoRepair equipment slot whose rate is not decoded), so the 'hold' block, the capture-by-repair rule and the faction repair crew are remake design values. 'default' is used by every game without its own block; a game's block overrides single keys.

capture.text: A unit whose repair work touches an object of a team that is not allied to him takes it for this long (or until it is destroyed or its owner repairs it back); then it returns to its owner.

hold.text: A Herc without a repair pack holds the repair action next to a structure: the structure regains this share of its hit points per second while the Herc stays within reach_m of its surface (remake values; the originals have no field repair for Hercs).

tribes.note: RepairBolt::onAcquire repairRate 0.1 for every target but the user (players too).

tribes2.note: RepairGunImage repairFactorPlayer (half of repairFactorObject) for a player, repairFactorObject for vehicles and objects.

es1.note: Earthsiege 1 structures (Structure): remake capture and hold rules.

es2.note: Earthsiege 2 structures: remake capture and hold rules.

starsiege.note: Starsiege structures (SSStructure): remake capture and hold rules.

faction_repair.text: A guard soldier of a faction walks to the nearest damaged or downed object of its own side (generators first, one soldier per object) and repairs it at the pack's object repair rate.
